proposition: The dissertation calls the 827-29/1425-27 stay at Shāhrukh's court in Herat Ibn Turka's 'first trip' (pp.78-79), yet describes the Iʿtiqādāt, written in Herat by 19 Jumādā I 829/29 March 1426, as written on his 'second trip to Herat' (p.92), and dates the Asrār al-Ṣalāt to Herat in 820/1417 (p.85); the numbering of his visits cannot be settled from these pages.
